item.body:
### Summary
As a member replying on iPhone, I want to keep scrolling the topic above the open composer, so that I can re-read the messages I am answering while I type.

### Observed (operator, device, 2026-11-12)
- With the reply composer open (docked card, keyboard up), the page above it no longer scrolls: drags on the visible messages do nothing.
- Screenshot kept locally by the operator (real member pseudos, not attached).

### Expected
The page above the docked card stays undimmed **and scrollable**, as decided by the operator on 2026-11-10 (#653) and as the code intends.

### Pointers
- `App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ComposerHeight.swift:90-110` (`PartialComposerSheet`): `.presentationBackgroundInteraction(pageScrolls && height == .partial ? .enabled(upThrough: detent) : .automatic)`. On device the page does not scroll: check which input is false or wrong there (`pageScrolls`, i.e. `TopicReaderModel.suspendsPageInteractions`; `height == .partial`; whether `detent` is the sheet's current detent once the keyboard is up and the card has grown).
- Legacy reference: `HFRswift/Swift/AnswerView.swift` @ 87fe0d1c is a full-screen cover (GAP-653); this behaviour is the operator's design choice for the docked card, not a port.
- Follow-up of #749 (#653).

### Acceptance criteria
- iPhone 18 Pro (iOS 27), keyboard up and keyboard down: a drag on the page above the composer scrolls the page; the composer keeps its text and focus.
- A tap on the page still does not open links or menus while the composer is open (`suspendsPageInteractions`).
- A test fails without the fix (the modifier's interaction for the composer's state at partial height, keyboard up).
